changelog: The bump is dependable. When you say you are stuck, your agent now reliably checks whether someone you know is here working on the same thing. Before, if you pasted the problem straight into the prompt, it usually just answered and never looked.
features: Say you are stuck ("I'm stuck", "going in circles") and the agent is quietly reminded, once per session, that it can look for someone near
You still get help with the problem first
It only ever names people you know, nothing is sent, and nothing leaves your machine to make this work
Quiet turns it off with everything else
